scripts.build: pnpm install && pnpm --filter react-shell-app build && pnpm --filter shell-prod-server build
scripts.start:dev: concurrently -n nuxt,qwik,react,server,payment -c green,blue,yellow,cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter nuxt-product-catalog dev" "pnpm --filter qwik-shopping-cart dev" "pnpm --filter react-shell-app dev" "pnpm --filter shell-prod-server dev:react" "pnpm --filter @demongbe/payment dev"
scripts.start:prod: pnpm build:all && concurrently -n nuxt,qwik,server,payment -c green,blue,cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter nuxt-product-catalog preview" "pnpm --filter qwik-shopping-cart preview" "pnpm --filter shell-prod-server start:server:react" "pnpm --filter @demongbe/payment start"
